title: How people are hitting 6 stars in GTA 6 🚨 #gta6 #shorts
description: PC Gamer only reached six stars by stealing a tank from a military base.

scenes.say: Getting six stars in GTA 6 is way harder than you think.
PC Gamer only hit six stars after stealing a tank from a military base.
Then they blew up other tanks and vehicles. That's what it takes.
What's the longest you've survived at six stars?
